There are open Cell Tracking Challenge datasets that could prove to be useful (haven't done extensive experiments with them yet).

As per the data usage term "3) Any public non-CTC-related, scientific use of our datasets requires explicit permission from the challenge organizers." on the site, I e-mailed the challenge organizers and they permitted the usage of the datasets, given the proper citation is included in the solution description.

So I share the link here with the community
